UGA.note: Regional IXPs are mentioned only in general; no Ugandan exchange point is named.
Only cross-border border points are listed, no national backbone.

facts.fact: A Uganda Communications Commission presentation says landlocked Uganda connects to submarine cables through Mombasa in Kenya and Dar es Salaam in Tanzania, with SEACOM and EASSy the primary cables, and lists operating cross-border interconnections at Busia and Malaba with Kenya and Mutukula with Tanzania.
facts.system: Uganda cross-border fibre via Kenya and Tanzania

systems.system: Uganda cross-border fibre via Kenya and Tanzania
systems.platform: terrestrial fibre to SEACOM and EASSy landings
